# Mirage 1.1.2

本版本重点提升 Wallpaper Engine 场景脚本与动态用户属性的兼容性，并修复自定义着色器、动态网格、媒体纹理和部分随时间变化场景的渲染问题。

## 重大更新：场景脚本与动态用户属性兼容性

- 修复容器和图层脚本的 `thisLayer`、`thisObject` 绑定，补齐延迟回调、媒体事件和动画事件中的脚本上下文；脚本控制的效果可正确获取并驱动对应效果的动画与可见性。
- 支持更多 Wallpaper Engine 场景脚本行为：字段脚本可以直接控制隐式动画，场景编译器也能识别嵌套对象中的脚本绑定，减少脚本未被初始化或媒体过渡不生效的问题。
- 用户属性现在可以在运行时更新图像/文字图层缩放、文字字体和最大宽度，并可实时控制 Bloom 开关及其参数，无需重新加载壁纸。
- 修复部分场景无法使用“随时间变化”或手动切换场景时间的问题（Issue #51）。

## 场景渲染与着色器修复

- 修复自定义着色器中矩阵和数组 uniform 未按 Vulkan `std140` 对齐规则填充的问题，并改进纹理槽引用识别，提升复杂材质的兼容性。
- 修复动态网格缓冲区首次分配后未写入初始顶点/索引数据的问题，避免部分动态几何体首帧显示异常。
- 修复绑定系统媒体纹理的纯色图层仍使用原始颜色 tint 的问题，避免媒体纹理出现错误着色或异常色块。

## 下载

- `arm64`：Apple Silicon Mac
- `x86_64`：Intel Mac
- 应用与屏保组件要求 macOS 14.2 或更高版本；原生动态锁屏功能要求 macOS 26 或更高版本

当前构建使用临时签名，首次打开时可能需要在「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性」中选择“仍要打开”。

# Mirage 1.1.2

This release substantially improves Wallpaper Engine Scene script and dynamic user-property compatibility, while fixing rendering issues involving custom shaders, dynamic meshes, media textures, and some time-based scenes.

## Major Update: Scene Scripts and Dynamic User Properties

- Fixed `thisLayer` and `thisObject` binding for container and layer scripts, including deferred callbacks, media events, and animation events. Scripts controlling effects can now access and drive the correct effect's animation and visibility.
- Expanded Wallpaper Engine script compatibility: field scripts can control their implicit animation directly, and scripts nested in object field bindings are now detected during Scene compilation, reducing cases where scripts were never initialized or media transitions had no effect.
- User properties can now update image/text layer scale, text fonts, and text maximum width at runtime, and can control Bloom enablement and parameters live without reloading the wallpaper.
- Fixed some scenes being unable to use time-based changes or manually switch their scene time (Issue #51).

## Scene Rendering and Shader Fixes

- Fixed matrix and array uniforms in custom shaders not being padded according to Vulkan `std140` alignment rules, and improved texture-slot reference detection for better compatibility with complex materials.
- Fixed dynamic mesh buffers not being seeded with their initial vertex/index data after allocation, which could make some dynamic geometry render incorrectly on its first frame.
- Fixed solid-color layers bound to system media textures retaining their authored tint, preventing incorrect coloring and unexpected color blocks in media-backed layers.

## Downloads

- `arm64` for Apple Silicon Mac
- `x86_64` for Intel Mac
- The app and screen-saver component require macOS 14.2 or later; native dynamic lock-screen features require macOS 26 or later

Builds use ad-hoc signing; macOS may require “Open Anyway” under System Settings → Privacy & Security on first launch.

</details>
